Risk deskRun the book

A toy sportsbook takes bets on this game at our margined price. Casual money splits in line with our fair odds. Sharp money bets whenever the market proxy says our price is off, sized by the edge. Flip suspensions off to see what stale prices cost when a fast bettor hits the line right after a big play.

          Report cardDoes it hold up?

          Head to head

          Lower Brier and log loss are better, higher AUC is better. Gap is our Brier minus the market proxy's, with a 95% interval from resampling whole games. Gold marks the best in each column.

          Calibration, zoomed in

          Actual win rate minus predicted, in points. Above zero means teams won more often than the model said. Below zero on the right and above zero on the left means the model is too confident. The shaded band is a 95% interval for the model you pick.

          By situation

          Brier score on the snaps that matter most for live pricing. Gold is best.
